metadata.note: First-party Claude API list rates. Partner-operated platforms (Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud) price separately and are not covered here. Costs derived from this table are estimates: they ignore negotiated discounts, the Batch API discount, the us-only inference-geo multiplier, fast mode, and per-search or per-container server-tool charges.

unknownModel.note: A model absent from this table renders as n/a and is left out of every total. Never substitute a guessed or nearest-neighbour rate.

claude-sonnet-5.note: The $2/$10 launch rate became the standard price; the increase to $3/$15 scheduled for 2026-09-01 was cancelled.
